title: Classic Greek Beef Stifado
description: A traditional Greek beef stew that's hearty and flavorful, made with tender beef, onions, garlic, and a rich, sweet sauce.
instructions: 1. Cut the beef into 1-inch cubes and season with salt and black pepper.
2. Heat the diced bacon in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Once crispy, remove the bacon from the pot and set aside.
3. Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
4. Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
5. Add the beef to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
6. Sprinkle the flour over the beef and cook for 1 minute.
7. Add the red wine vinegar, grape molasses, brown sugar, cinnamon, and cumin to the pot. Stir to combine.
8. Return the bacon to the pot and bring the mixture to a simmer.
9. Reduce the heat to low and let the stifado cook, covered, for 2-3 hours, or until the beef is tender.
10. Serve the stifado hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
